adapters: Only physical allocation/free and memcpy boundaries. Actual reader,ordered8-byte table insertion/growth,24-byte binding removal/shift/growth,curve allocation/copy-state and Meter factory/Init/Term execute.
findings: All matching parameter+curve IDs are removed before insertion;curve point arrays freed then remaining24-byte records shifted in order.
Pair duplicates replace first matching value without increasing count. Pair growth increment8 and binding growth increment2 preserve raw unused bytes.
Curve allocation failure leaves zero pointer/count/scaling;reader ignores failures and continues consuming all payload.
limits: Controlled valid table storage,point backing and Meter plugin only. Other plugin Init failures,unusual malformed storage and repeated byte-table replacement ownership still require qualification.
Copied curve fields are retained without evaluating or subscribing them;normal HIRC dispatch,subscription/RTPC propagation/device output remain open.
